env.pop('OTERYN_TEST_POSTGRES_ADMIN_URL',None)

def run(label,args,expected=0,pg_enabled=False):

def check(binary,name,label,expected=0):
    listed=run(label+'_list',[binary,name,'--exact','--list','--format','terse'])
    assert listed.splitlines()==[name+': test'],listed
    before_connections=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','docker','logs','oteryn-test-ci-value-audit-durability-20261123'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    before_connection_lines=set((before_connections.stdout+before_connections.stderr).splitlines())
    output=run(label,[binary,'--exact',name,'--nocapture'],expected,True)
    after_connections=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','docker','logs','oteryn-test-ci-value-audit-durability-20261123'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert before_connections.returncode==after_connections.returncode==0
    observed=[line for line in (after_connections.stdout+after_connections.stderr).splitlines() if line not in before_connection_lines and 'connection authorized:' in line and ('native_source_floor' in line or 'native_source_slots' in line)]
    assert observed,(label,'no new actual case database connection')
    assert 'PRE-ROUTING / NONCANONICAL' not in output and 'DURABILITY_ROOT_REESTABLISHED' in output,(label,'configured body marker missing')
    metadata['commands'][-1]['actual_pg_case_connections']=observed;save()
    summary='test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed;' if expected==0 else 'test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed;'
    assert summary in output,output[-2000:]

def item(text,name):
    start=text.index('fn '+name+'(');opening=text.index('{',start);depth=0;quoted=False;escaped=False;comment=False
    for i in range(opening,len(text)):
        ch=text[i]
        if comment:
            if ch=='\n':comment=False
            continue
        if quoted:
            if escaped:escaped=False
            elif ch=='\\':escaped=True
            elif ch=='"':quoted=False
            continue
        if ch=='"':quoted=True;continue
        if text[i:i+2]=='//':comment=True;continue
        if ch=='{':depth+=1
        elif ch=='}':
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return text[start:i+1]
    raise ValueError(name)

    binary=build('native_size_guard_deleted_build')
